method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (sda-home.l4, fhog-grant.l4, sda-vehicles.l4, taa-procedure.l4, with shared terms in fhog-terms.l4 and helpers in sda-common.l4) holding 12 regulative rules, and a seat layer (sda-seat.l4, 25 exported questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a pre-6 June 2024 contract in the s 71DD phase-out band, grant amounts before 15 October 2012, a non-new-home grant before 1 July 2014 and a registration over 12 months answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Every text is the Open Australian Legal Corpus (v7.1.0) text, not the official one, and may be out of date. Stamp Duties Act 1923 as at 2025-02-13 (scraped 2025-03-10), ../../registers/source-bundle/stamp-duties-act-1923.txt; First Home and Housing Construction Grants Act 2000 as at 2025-02-13 (scraped 2025-03-10; listed at 4.12.2025, so a later version exists); First Home and Housing Construction Grants Regulations 2015 as at 2021-03-11; Stamp Duties Regulations 2013 as at 2022-09-29; Taxation Administration Act 1996 as at 2019-10-03 (a later version, 4.12.2025, is listed). The duty scale and grant amounts are encoded as the deposited text states them. Inputs: the 'relevant day' of each Act (not in the operative text; the deposited legislative history records 13.2.2025), the market rate (TAA s 26(2), Regulations 2015 reg 6(3)), and the Commissioner's approvals, opinions and determinations. Formulas missing from the deposit (s 71DD(7), s 71DB, s 42BA, FHOG ss 18B-18BAC) give `not covered`.

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run sda-common.l4 ; l4 run fhog-terms.l4 ; l4 run taa-procedure.l4 ; l4 run sda-home.l4 ; l4 run fhog-grant.l4 ; l4 run sda-vehicles.l4 ; l4 run sda-seat.l4 ; l4 run sda-cases-home.l4 ; l4 run fhog-cases.l4 ; l4 run sda-cases-vehicles.l4 ; l4 run taa-cases.l4 ; l4 run sda-cases-seat.l4
checks.result: 375 assertions satisfied (129 home, 102 grant, 48 vehicles, 39 TAA, 57 seat), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 11 #TRACEs with an expect line (5 breaches, 6 obligations pending), each read and as expected; a control copy with one expected value altered failed as it should
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the buyer of a home or a car in South Australia, including the first home buyer applying for the s 71DD relief and the first home owner grant. Stamp Duties Act: s 2 (spouse, domestic partner, foreign person for an individual); s 20(1), (2), (4)-(7) (regulative); s 60A(1), (2); Schedule 2 clause 3(1)(b) (the general scale, as a table); s 71CB; s 71DD(1)-(3), (6), (8), (9), (11), (11a), (12), (13); s 71DD(4), (5) with s 71DE (regulative); s 72(1)-(5), (8) (refund regulative); ss 42A, 42B and Schedule 2 clause 2(1)-(4) (registration component tables, $5 minimum, exemptions 4, 6, 11; policy component, exemptions 2, 6, 8). Stamp Duties Regulations 2013 reg 14. First Home and Housing Construction Grants Act 2000: ss 3-6, 7, 8, 8A, 9, 10, 11, 12 with 20 (regulative), 13, 14(5), (6) with 17, 24 (regulative), 15, 18(1), (4a), 18BB, 18C, 21(2)-(4), 25 with 27, 28 (regulative), 39 (regulative), 40; Regulations 2015 reg 6. Taxation Administration Act 1996: ss 25-27, 29-34, 82, 86, 87, 89, 92-95 (regulative). Out: s 71DB (formula missing), s 42BA (formula missing), s 71DD(7) (formula missing), s 71DD(9a), landholder duty, ss 71C-71CC, 71CBA, 71D-71DC, 71E-71F, s 72(6), (7), corporate and trust foreign persons, other vehicle exemptions, ss 42C, 42CA, FHOG s 6A (HomeBuilder), ss 12A, 12B, 18B-18BAC, 13A, 18(2), 13(6), 16, 22, 23, s 5(4)-(6), and TAA machinery.
